QuestInfo.name: [Join] I am a Valerie Fan
QuestInfo.0: 3 citizens of Maple World are competing to be the Maple Rising Star! Become a fan of Valerie, and help her live her dream!
QuestInfo.1: Valerie has great dance moves and a fantastic voice, but can be a little unruly. By cheering her on, maybe you can help her win! Head to the #rRising Star Hall#k via Dimensional Mirror to meet her.
QuestInfo.2: Cheer for your chosen star, Valerie!

0.0: Hi there, #b#h0##k. Have you been keeping up with the Maple Rising Star Contest? It's being held to celebrate the Maple 7th Anniversary. Countless people have competed to become the star of Maple World, but they're down to the final 3 contestants now.
0.1: The finalists include #bCygnus#k, who was born with natural grace and a lovely singing voice; the tomboy #bValerie#k, who has amazing moves and an even more amazing voice; and #bLilin#k, who is adorably sincere, full of potential, and impressively driven. #rDuring the 7th Anniversary Event#k, these three will be competing to become the #rMaple Rising Star#k.
0.2: So, #b#h0##k. How do you feel about joining #bValerie's#k fan club, and cheering her on to victory? This is an important decision for you, you know. #rYou can leave a fan club that you have joined, but your fan club progress will be reset#k. Are you going to stand by #bValerie#k?

yes.0: You can take the #bDimensional Mirror#k in town to the #rRising Star Hall#k. There, you can meet the three contestants, including Valerie.
yes.1: Meet Valerie and tell her that you will join her fan club!

no.0: Don't you care about the Maple Rising Star Contest? It's the biggest competition of the year!

1.0: Oh, #b#h0##k! You must be here to lend your support. Thank you so much.
1.1: As a member of my fan club, please keep me in your thoughts, and help me become the Maple Rising Star!

npc.0: You met Valerie by taking the Dimensional Mirror in town to the Rising Star Hall.
